> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **16** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7ff853b044d774b667dfdfe993235e0ee74eddd1` — the merge of head `7fe6ffdde1cf4842bdd4b482549d6a5f7780405b` into base `394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7ff853b044d774b667dfdfe993235e0ee74eddd1 && git checkout 7ff853b044d774b667dfdfe993235e0ee74eddd1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520 7fe6ffdde1cf4842bdd4b482549d6a5f7780405b && git checkout -B drift-repro 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520 && git merge --no-ff 7fe6ffdde1cf4842bdd4b482549d6a5f7780405b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7fe6ffdde1cf4842bdd4b482549d6a5f7780405b`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #23434 (body and all 8 comments, ruling of record `6165388570` letter C, seat reading `6168576479`, dev reports `6168538808` and `6170782619`), PR #23502 (body, 46-file list, net diff +252/−2647 against `main`), the 39 check-runs on the head (read once). Repo read-only; no worktree, build, test or gate run. One read outside the listed inputs, disclosed: `git cat-file -t` on the sibling objectui clone for the 13 shas the moved notes cite (all resolve to commits); the symbols themselves were NOT resolved by this review and rest on the dev's claim.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set: **no change, judged right.** Every hunk under `packages/spec/src/**` is docblock, test-header comment, or a string inside a v18 migration `reason`. No `z.*` shape, refinement, default, `retiredKey`, export or refusal moves. The one `.describe()` touched is `FormFieldBaseSchema.span` (`ui/view.zod.ts`), whose text drops the pin sentence (`at the pin this repo builds against (.objectui-sha = b9814b334d8a)`) and keeps the behaviour clause verbatim; `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` is regenerated to match (2 rows, both the same string). That is a published-prose change, not a contract change — right.

Public surface, each named:
- `packages/spec/liveness/{action,dashboard,field,report,translation,view}.json` — `note` fields only, 19 rows, additive (the prior note text is kept byte-for-byte and a sentence is appended). The ledger SHIPS (`files[]`), so this is a published-artifact change at patch level — right. `Spec property liveness` check-run: success.
- `packages/spec/package.json` — one `check:*` script removed; dev-only, not a consumer surface — right.
- `packages/spec/scripts/check-objectui-pin-citations.ts` deleted (1,363 lines); `check-generated.ts` loses the matching `NO_GENERATOR` row (the `--reconcile-only` pairing stays balanced: script and row go together) — right.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — the one step `check-spec-pin-citations-still-name-the-pin` removed; its `id` is referenced nowhere else in `.github/**` — right. Tier H hunk.
- `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` — `CENSUS_REFUSE_WIDE` row removed, prose re-counted to thirteen; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` — prose only. Routing of the family was derived from the deleted script's own watch-hint header (`extractWatchHints`), so deleting the script retires the routing — right.

Brief items judged:
- (a) **No accept/refuse/export change anywhere** — holds on every file; `Clause-②: no` is right (PR body and changeset both carry it).
- (b) **Moved citations land in real rows, nothing lost.** Every source citation deleted by the diff (sha + objectui file) has a counterpart appended to a row whose key exists in the ledger: `view.json` `list.calendar` / `list.gantt` / `list.timeline` / `list.map` (the completeness table's four rows plus the `ListMapConfigSchema` strictness record's seven anchors, `view.test.ts` `style`, `view-overlay-options-bag.test.ts`) / `list.chart` (`resolveListChartBinding` @f0268ad7) / `form.sections` (`resolveColSpan`, `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`, `spanLadderFor`); `action.json` `outcomeMessages` (`composeSuccessMessage`), `onSuccess.navigate` (`execute` / `handlePostExecution` / `readOnSuccessNavigation` @1fb1ced36243, from `action-on-success-executor.ts`), `aria`; `dashboard.json` `widgets` (`complex.zod.ts#DashboardWidgetSchema` @53ded82bf7a4), `widgets.values` (`AdvancedChartImplInner` @89cad75d5570), `widgets.chartConfig.aria`; `report.json` `chart`, `blocks`; `field.json` `options` (`SelectCellRenderer` @d8ec8d6d4f01), `scale` (`normalizeSectionField`, `NumberCellRenderer` @53ded82bf7, the @89cad75d5570 and @62597c588072 readings, the retired spec-bridge note from `scale-ceiling.ts`), `inlineColumns` (`hydrateColumns` / `fieldTypeToColumnType` @db11afd4967c, `SORT_FIELD_NAMES` @89cad75d5570, `deriveFormFields` / `MasterDetailLines` @31971ff1e28f); `translation.json` `flows.label` (@0abd4f9f8), `flows.screens` (@f8a9d0fb). 36 distinct `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` strings were added to the ledger; no added ledger line carries a `FILE:LINE` objectui anchor. The shortened source prose names the receiving row in every case. Two minor spellings, not failing: the `InterfaceListPage.mapConfig.test.tsx` control in `list.map` is cited by file and test title with no `#symbol`, and the `plugin-map.mdx` mention carries no `@sha` of its own (it sits inside a sentence dated at `@b9814b334`). The `translation.json` additions name no new symbol, but the rows' `evidence` fields already carry the `FlowRunner` symbols at `@0abd4f9f8` / `@31971ff1e`, so the read points are in the ledger. Judged right.
- (c) **Respelled citations no longer claim the pin.** 43 single-line asserting spellings are deleted; the remaining asserting records were multi-line (`action.zod.ts`, `action-outcome-messages.test.ts`, `scale-ceiling.ts`, `component.zod.ts` `:4570`) and are either moved or respelled. No `+` line in the diff carries `.objectui-sha` followed by `=`, and no `+` line under `packages/spec/src` says `builds against`. Each respell reads `at objectui b9814b334 (re-read there 2026-10-14: …)`. The 49 count is the dev's gate `--list` figure and is consistent with 43 single-line plus the multi-line ones in the diff. Right.
- (d) **Retirement complete.** Every reference to `check:objectui-pin-citations` / `check-objectui-pin-citations` on the tree is in the diff's `−` lines: `lint.yml` (rationale comment and step), `package.json`, `check-generated.ts` (row and sibling comment), `check-llms-txt.ts`, `component.zod.ts` `:3367`, `view.zod.ts` `:2404`, `bare-root-worklist.mjs` (prose ×2, row), `dispatch-gates.mjs` prose. What remains names it as history only: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and two `.changeset/pre/20471-*.md` fragments — right to leave. No other workflow, `turbo.json`, docs page or script calls it. Right.
- (e) **Six migration `reason` strings.** Each of the six v18 entries changes only the clause that named the pin: `the pinned objectui checkout — the pin this repo builds against, .objectui-sha = b9814b334… —` becomes `the objectui checkout at b9814b334… (the pin when this was measured / re-read)`. The measured counts, controls and hop lists after it are untouched. Says only what was measured. Right. These are NOT the two entries ruling item 4 fences off (`18.element-data-source-…`, `18.object-block-sort-item-array`), which the diff does not touch.
- (f) **Tier H and 速读.** `lint.yml` is in the file list, so the PR is Tier H and lands on the maintainer's merge; the body carries `## 维护者速读(草稿)` with 改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价(含回滚) / 席位意见 (empty, draft) / 你要做的. Right.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23434-objectui-read-points-to-ledger.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. What the diff publishes from `@objectstack/spec`: changed docblock prose in shipped `.d.ts`/source, one changed `.describe()` string (`span`), appended ledger notes in the shipped `liveness/*.json`, and the regenerated reference doc. No type, export, default or refusal moves, so patch is the right level and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong. The changeset body names what the source stops carrying (ruling item 5) and lists what PR-2 still owes. Root tooling (`scripts/pm/**`, `.github/**`) is unpublished and owes no changeset. `Check Changeset`: success.

Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags and `open_questions`, each answered or escalated:
1. **Deviation 1 — three group-M citations re-classified to group C** (`ui/page.zod.ts` `visibleWhen` roots; `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts` master-detail and `record:line_items` key sets). They are `ComponentPropsMap` members with no row below `page.regions`; the seat reading (`6168576479`) routes group C to PR-2. Answered: consistent with the seat reading; those files keep their (historical) citations in source for now, which PR-2 must move.
2. **Deviation 2 — two moves held back for size** (`api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` → `object.json` `enable.apiMethods`; `dataset.zod.ts` → `dataset.json` `measures.format`). Both respelled here (`at objectui b9814b334`), so neither claims the pin; the moved form is in the dev's scratchpad patch. Escalated to the seat: the seat reading said PR-1 moves "the 43 that have a row", and the hold-back instruction is recorded only in the dev report, not on the card. PR-2's claim must list both files explicitly or the ledger will be short two rows the reading promised.
3. **Open question (report `6170782619`) — renderer citations outside the gate's population** (`objectui SHA … ListView.tsx:5716` in `view.zod.ts`; sha-less `at the .objectui-sha pin` mentions in `dashboard.zod.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `i18n-resolver.ts`). Not in the ruled 37/98 population and not changed here; correctly recorded, not changed. Escalated: ruling item 1's sentence ("the published spec source carries no renderer citation") reaches them literally, so the seat should put the dev's A/B to the maintainer alongside Q2 before PR-2 is dispatched. Does not block PR-1.
4. **Q2 (retirement-history group R, 40 citations)** stays with the maintainer per the seat reading; PR-1 touches it only through the six asserting respells, which Q2 option A also prescribes. No conflict with any Q2 answer.
5. **`check:platform-checklist` red** (8 ABSENT SYMBOL findings into `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts`). The diff touches neither file; main-side drift. Not this PR's red; the dev's out-of-scope note names a carrier. The `Lint · docs & code guards` check-run (in progress) is where it would surface on the head.
6. **NOT MEASURED gates** (`check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) need the CLI or a whole-repo dist; none reads docblock prose or the ledger, and the head's `Lint · *` / `Test Core` runs cover them.
7. Claim file-surface: the diff stays inside the amended claim (`6168576479` added `check-generated.ts`, `check-llms-txt.ts`, the two prose mentions); `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` and `docs/releases-maintenance.md` are untouched as ruled (item 4). `chart.zod.ts` and the six migration entries are inside `packages/spec/src/**` and carried asserting or group-M records, so they are in surface. No breach.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #23502 · `domain:spec` seat 3 · 2026-10-14T14:40Z

Session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz` · `baozhoutao`. Head `7fe6ffdde`; contract review PASS on this head (record above). Tier H (`.github/workflows/lint.yml`): this PR lands only on your approval.

**改了什么**
这是 #23434 裁决 C 的第一半(`Part of #23434`)。① 退役 `check:objectui-pin-citations` 门禁:删掉脚本、package 脚本、`lint.yml` 那一步,以及 PM 工具里对它的引用。② spec 源码里 49 处"声称跟随当前 objectui pin"的引用,改写成"在 objectui `b9814b334` 读到"的日期读数,不再跟着 pin 走。③ 有对应台账行的 38 处引用,搬进 `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` 的 note,写成 `objectui @SHA 文件#符号`,源码里删掉。共 46 个文件,+252/−2647(大头是删掉的门禁脚本 1,363 行)。

**为什么改**
您问「升级 objectui pin，为什么会导致 spec 协议变更」:原因是这个门禁要求每次 pin 升级都改写 spec 源码里的引用。本 PR 落地后,升级 pin 不再触碰 `packages/spec/src`。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只动注释、台账 note 和门禁,不改任何 schema、类型、导出或默认值(`Clause-②: no`)。回滚 = revert 本 PR(门禁会回来,49 处引用回到断言写法)。余下两组(组件属性 99 处、退役历史 40 处)和两处为控制行数暂缓的搬迁留给 PR-2;退役历史那组等您对 #23434 Q2 的回答。

**席位意见**
建议批准。复核记录逐项核过:没有任何引用丢失(删掉的都在台账里有对应),改写后没有一处再声称跟随 pin,门禁的调用方全部清掉。

**你要做的(一个动作)**
在本 PR 点批准(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 任一)。批准后席位负责落地。
